selected_evidence.summary: Shows the original export contents/checksum, restored IDs and amounts, and unchanged export checksum after restart.
SHOW GRANTS reports only REPLICATION SLAVE for the account restricted to node2.
Normal and post-restart inserts arrived with matching rows, totals, digests and binlog positions.
Node2 remained at three rows while disconnected, then caught up to five distinct rows with the same digest, position 2024, zero lag and no errors.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 sole writer and node2 read-only
selected_evidence.summary: Node1 reports read_only=0; node2 reports read_only=ON and rejects a non-privileged INSERT with error 1290, leaving no test row.
Both nodes remain AlmaLinux 9.6 on kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 before and after changes.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered active/read-only replica with intact data and zero lag.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered primary and export, followed by successful post-restart replication to node2.
